evidence: Has the 'Wallet' label and modifies wallet transaction rebroadcast and mempool resubmission logic in src/wallet/wallet.cpp and src/wallet/wallet.h.
rationale: Prevents the wallet from re-adding evicted transactions to the local mempool and rebroadcasting them when `-privatebroadcast` is configured. As the author notes, users opting into private broadcast should not have dropped transactions or incoming dust rebroadcast over clearnet or served exclusively from their wallet's mempool.
